Regular ritual is not for them theweary chore it can soeasily become for the city-bred Westerner. Tantra,like mostother Indian cults, focuses all itsinterest on prescribed schemes ofbehaviour and imagery. Its texts are full of imperatives, which again some Westerners may find distasteful.
